name: Ferry passengers
textTemplate: A party of {pax}, patched coats and good manners, asks to be taken to {dest} in the {system} system within {days} days. They offer {pay} credits.

name: Rush delivery
textTemplate: {tons} t of {cargo} must reach {dest} in the {system} system within {days} days, and not an hour later. The sender pays {pay} credits on arrival.

name: Cargo transport
textTemplate: A merchant needs {tons} t of {cargo} hauled to {dest} in the {system} system within {days} days. The job pays {pay} credits.

name: Cargo shipment
textTemplate: A trading house wants {tons} t of {cargo} carried the long way to {dest} in the {system} system within {days} days. It pays {pay} credits to a pilot with the hold for it.

name: Cargo delivery
textTemplate: A shopkeeper asks you to drop {tons} t of {cargo} at {dest} in the {system} system, one jump away, within {days} days. They will pay {pay} credits.

name: Dump garbage
textTemplate: The port office pays {pay} credits up front for you to haul {tons} t of sealed garbage to {dest} in the {system} system. Nobody will check how long you take.
